finding.root_cause: The frozen precondition requires verified persisted root/owner equivalence before implementation. Existing readback and historical receipts do not expose the complete captures. Moreover capture.created_by has two different producer semantics and alias.root_path_hash is not a root hash, so neither field can be used as an ownership/root equivalence shortcut.

source_facts.fact: Calls bind_task_to_workspace with identity.agent_id as created_by. This is the attesting agent, not a proven operating-system workspace owner.

Captures contain root and manifest hashes; normal create supplies peer.owner_key as created_by. Equal created_by values cannot be imposed as a uniform owner rule across attested and ordinary captures.
root_path_hash is computed from registry_instance_id.as_bytes(), not from the project root. This existing numeric reconciliation alias is not a legacy-to-canonical root attestation.
legacy_capture records wc-ws-1-355448432, workspace 1 and ws-1 only; it does not contain the complete root/manifest/owner proof. The receipt's historical claims are not treated as current authority.

finding.impact_radius: Canonical children under the historical Epic T-1787203926824-9f873bfc; no finding asserted against unrelated tasks.
finding.impact: Current exact-instance rejection remains in force. Relaxing it based only on workspace_id, created_by or alias.root_path_hash would not meet the frozen authority proof requirement.
finding.minimal_fix: Planner should revise this same task, not create nested remediation cards: identify an existing supported read-only complete capture/owner proof source, or authorize a bounded task-owned authority-proof readback and explicit owner provenance resolution before implementing the bridge. Persisted source records must be verified; absent or ambiguous evidence must continue to reject.
finding.acceptance: Preflight returns independently verifiable legacy and canonical capture hashes, real root agreement and a documented registered owner provenance chain. A missing source remains a structured rejection; no old capture/binding rewrite and no numeric-only equivalence.

resolution_of_concerns.created_by_semantics: The implemented bridge does NOT use created_by as an owner/root equivalence shortcut. Equivalence is proven exclusively from daemon-persisted capture columns (client_view_root_hash, host_real_root_hash, registry_identity_payload_json) plus numeric workspace identity.
resolution_of_concerns.alias_root_path_hash: record_reconciliation_alias's synthetic sha256(instance) root_path_hash is left untouched. The bridge writes its own equivalence provenance row with the REAL shared root hash.

implementation.bounded_proof_semantics: On instance mismatch inside validate_parent_for_child_create, permit a canonical child ONLY when: parent capture instance is legacy ws-<digits>; both parent and canonical latest captures are immutable self-consistent (client_root == host_root, non-empty); requested instance exists in the daemon-persisted capture domain with a UNIQUE numeric workspace equal to parent AND requested workspace id; shared root hash byte-equal across both captures; registry identity payload of both captures cross-proves the shared root/instance. Otherwise fail-closed E_WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH.
implementation.provenance: On success, one append-only row is inserted into workspace_reconciliation_aliases (alias_id wa-<canonical>-<legacy>, root_path_hash = real shared root hash) inside the same create transaction; idempotent via existing unique index. Historical binding/capture rows are never rewritten; legacy instance is never propagated to the new task; exact numeric workspace rejection is preserved (workspace equality step unchanged).
